declarations.reason:
Asserts that no file outside vyre-spec declares a `TOK_`-prefixed constant. A
second numbering table in a crate vyre-spec does not depend on is not linked
into any program this test could run, so no execution can witness it; the
duplicate only shows up as a wrong parse on the GPU much later.

Floor check for the walk the gate above depends on. Its subject is the file set
that walk produced, which exists only inside the source scan.

Resolves every `--test`/`--bin` name a CI workflow step passes against the
cargo targets that package declares or auto-discovers. A workflow step is text
until CI runs it, and a target named by a step is not reachable from any
process running locally.

Asserts that exactly one implementation of the ceiling division exists. A
behavioural parity sweep catches a copy that rounds differently and passes a
copy that agrees today, and a second implementation that agrees today is the
defect this closes: the copies it replaced agreed until the zero case.

Asserts that the owner of the dispatch-grid helper is declared unconditionally
in the crate that holds it and that every crate with a dispatch-grid function
reaches it through a non-optional dependency edge. Reachability is decided at
compile time, so a build where the owner is unreachable is a build in which
this test does not run.

Asserts that no file in the workspace respells a binding record's full name set
instead of naming the record's canonical constant. Two spellings that agree
produce identical behaviour, which is why the drift it exists for went
unnoticed; only the source distinguishes them.

Asserts that every declared `*Buffers` record publishes canonical names. The
subject is the set of declared types, which a running program cannot enumerate
without reflection.

Asserts that every op calling `routed_persistent_fixpoint` also registers with
the shared routing contract. An op that never registers runs correctly on the
inputs it does have, so the omission has no run-time symptom until a dispatch
spans more than one workgroup in production.

Asserts that no file outside the routing owner observes both halves of the
routing obligation itself. A private copy of an assertion passes, which is the
whole reason a copy survives; only the source shows there are two.

Asserts that no production caller bypasses the shared persistent-fixpoint
routing owner. The subject is source ownership: an unrouted direct call can
execute correctly below one workgroup and exposes the race only on a wider
dispatch.

Asserts that no operation registration is gated behind a Cargo feature this
crate's dependency edge leaves off. An invisible registration is
indistinguishable from an absent one at run time: the walker reports a smaller
registry and every document generated from it agrees.

Asserts that each source crate's widest aggregate feature turns on every
feature that gates a registration. The subject is that crate's feature table,
which is consumed by cargo before any code runs.

Derives the published ResidentCsrQueueMaterializer variant set from the source
that declares it, so a variant added without a step-sequence case is red on its
first run. A variant nothing exercises has no run-time witness: the property
being asserted is the absence of a case, which no execution can observe.

Derives the published quantized dispatch entry points from the `pub use
..._via` re-exports that declare them, so an entry point shipped without a
readback contract row is red on its first run. The subject is the public
export list, which no run of the covered entry points can report on.

Asserts that no crate except the parity oracle ships a `ProgramDispatcher` a
default build can construct. The subject is the absence of a type in crates this
test does not link, and a type nobody constructed is invisible to every running
program; the failure it prevents is a consumer reaching a host dispatcher years
later.

Floor check for the walk the gate above depends on. Its subject is the file set
that walk produced, which exists only inside the source scan.

Requires a recorded type answer for every declared `Expr` variant, with the
variant roster read from the source of the enum. Rust has no reflection, so a
variant added without an answer cannot be observed at run time: the typecheck
walk simply returns nothing for it, which is also what a legitimately untyped
expression returns.

Asserts that no build-task source except the dispatcher resolves the running
binary for itself. The wrong answer is only wrong in a binary that is not the
dispatcher, where the subcommand it would run does not exist, so a passing run
of the dispatcher witnesses nothing. The subject is a call another crate did not
make, which no execution observes.

Derives exported Program builders from Rust items and compares them with the
coverage table. Rust provides no run-time enumeration of exports, so only the
source can expose a newly exported builder without a coverage decision.

Resolves literal workflow and script invocations against Cargo target
declarations. The complete command census and target roster exist only as
source and manifest text.

Pairs the files under vyre-foundation/src/transform with the rows of
FOUNDATION_TRANSFORM_CLASSIFICATIONS. A transform file whose row is missing
still compiles and still runs; the classification table is what a release reads,
and no running program enumerates the directory the table is supposed to cover.

Compares the child slots `Node` declares with the slots `child_bodies`
destructures. Rust has no reflection over enum fields, so a slot the owner never
names is a body no traversal reaches and no execution reports.

Asserts that no source file resolves the checkout from a path baked in at
compile time. A binary built in one checkout and run against another reads the
build-time tree and passes; the wrong tree is visible only in the text that
names it.

Requires every dispatch method the forwarding macro emits to be specialized by
GridSyncSplitBackend or recorded as routing through the default. Both spellings
return the same type, so a method folded into the trait default is
indistinguishable from a specialized one until a program carrying a GridSync
barrier reaches a device with no cooperative launch. The method roster is a
macro body, which nothing enumerates at run time.

tree. Duplication is a property of the text. Two copies that agree today behave
identically, which is the defect, so no execution separates them.

Holds a shared crate's device module to backend-neutral vocabulary. A concrete
backend name in a shared crate compiles and runs; what it costs is the ability
to build without that backend, which no run of the built artifact reports.

Asserts the resident layout declarations exist in the owner and nowhere else. A
second declaration in a crate this test does not depend on is linked into no
program it could run, and diverges from the owner only once a device reads a
buffer laid out by the other copy.

Floor check for the dispatch-wrapper pairing the rules below are taken over. Its
subject is the file set that pairing produced, which exists only inside the
source walk; without it every rule in the file would pass by judging nothing.

Requires each dispatch wrapper to name the graph primitive it wraps and the CPU
reference that primitive publishes. A wrapper that reimplements the algorithm
instead of delegating answers correctly today and drifts on the first fix to the
primitive; a parity run cannot tell delegation from a copy that currently
agrees.

Requires each dispatch wrapper to name the graph primitive it wraps and the CPU
reference that primitive publishes. A wrapper that reimplements the algorithm
instead of delegating answers correctly today and drifts on the first fix to the
primitive; a parity run cannot tell delegation from a copy that currently
agrees.

Asserts the module a wrapper was migrated from no longer exists. A stale module
that nothing declares is compiled into no program, so no execution observes it,
and the next edit lands in whichever copy the author opens.

Counts the `mod` declaration for each wrapper in the dispatch module. Module
declarations are consumed by the compiler and are not enumerable at run time; a
wrapper declared twice or not at all is a source fact.

Holds the narrowing of a measured span to api::metric, which saturates, and
bans the truncating cast everywhere including the owner. The wrap it prevents
needs a span past about 18.4 seconds to show up, and then reports the slowest
sample as the fastest rather than failing, so a benchmark run witnesses nothing.
Which file spells the cast has no run-time witness at all.

Holds the wording of a failed payload downcast to api::case. Every copy produces
the same error type, so the drift this closes is in the sentence a caller reads,
which no assertion over behavior distinguishes.

Derives the CUDA dispatch paths from their calls to the launch helpers and
requires a recorded trap-reporting decision for each. Reaching every path at run
time takes a real device fault per path; a path added without a decision reports
a trap as success, which is the case that must fail before the device runs.

Asserts one file defines `expr_type`. A second definition compiles, and its
answers differ from the owner's only for the shapes the two happen to disagree
on, so a behavioral sweep proves the copy it calls and nothing about the other.

Requires every async rule in the catalog to be named by a case somewhere in this
crate's suite. The covered set is the suite's own sources: Rust exposes no
run-time roster of tests, and the list this replaced went stale the day a rule
landed with its case in another file.

Requires one NodeVisitor hook per declared `Node` variant, or a recorded reason
for the fold. Exhaustive dispatch makes a new variant a compile error, and
routing it into an existing hook silences that error just as well; a variant
folded into somebody else's hook is invisible to every implementor and to every
run.

Reads the NodeVisitor implementations out of workspace source. An implementation
in another crate is linked into nothing this test can run, and the stub bodies it
copies are indistinguishable from deliberate no-ops when executed.

Compares the constant folder with the interpreter for every operator and width.
The assertion is behavioral; the variant space is parsed from the operator enums
because Rust cannot enumerate variants at run time, and a hand-written roster
would let a new operator land proven nowhere while the suite stayed green.

Compares the constant folder with the interpreter for every operator and width.
The assertion is behavioral; the variant space is parsed from the operator enums
because Rust cannot enumerate variants at run time, and a hand-written roster
would let a new operator land proven nowhere while the suite stayed green.

Takes the narrowing targets from the cast table that owns which integer casts
the IR admits. The enum declares storage families the table excludes, so the
population is the table's, and it is readable only as source.

Requires every workspace member that submits a BackendRegistration to be
declared by this crate with a feature that links it. An undeclared submitter is
absent from the registry at run time, which reads exactly like a crate that
submits nothing.

Asserts one module constructs the wgpu instance. A second construction site is a
loader race: it works until two threads reach it at once, and then segfaults
inside the driver rather than failing an assertion.

Census of every nonzero exit in the xtask sources, each of which must state a
cause. Reaching all of them at run time means provoking every failure path of
every command; a silent exit is a source fact one parse reads completely.

Asserts no test source names the write trigger that regenerates artifacts. A
test that sets it passes; what it does is rewrite the evidence it was supposed to
check, so the run it corrupts is the run that would have to observe it.

Resolves every gate descriptor's proof symbol to a unique `#[test]` function in
the owning crate's source. Rust exposes no run-time roster of tests, so a
descriptor naming a test that was renamed or deleted claims proof that nothing
runs.

Resolves every package selector in every workflow and script of this checkout
against the manifests. A workflow step is text until CI runs it, and a selector
that resolves to nothing fails there rather than here.
